# Scotland EPC

> Scotland EPC (scotlandepc.com) provides domestic Energy Performance Certificates (EPCs) and legionella risk assessments for landlords, letting agents, sellers and homeowners across Glasgow, Edinburgh and the Central Belt of Scotland. It is part of Scottish Energy Services (https://www.scottishenergyservices.co.uk/), 272 Bath Street, Glasgow G2 4JR. EPCs are produced by accredited domestic energy assessors and lodged on the Scottish EPC Register, normally within 24 hours of the visit.

Key facts:
- Business: Scotland EPC, 272 Bath Street, Glasgow G2 4JR, Scotland. Phone 07483 881889 (+44 7483 881889)
- Prices, all excluding VAT (Glasgow G and Edinburgh EH postcodes): EPCs from £70 for a flat, £75 maisonette, £80 bungalow and £85 for a house; legionella risk assessment from £65; EPC and legionella together £120
- Travel supplement: £20 outside G and EH postcodes (for example Paisley, Hamilton, Falkirk, Stirling)
- Area served: Glasgow, Edinburgh, Bearsden, Milngavie, Bishopbriggs, Kirkintilloch, East Kilbride, Cumbernauld, Livingston, Bathgate, Linlithgow, Musselburgh, Dalkeith, Paisley, Renfrew, Hamilton, Motherwell, Falkirk, Stirling
- Turnaround: EPC normally lodged and emailed within 24 hours of the visit
- Scottish EPC rules: current EPCs valid 10 years; rating must appear in adverts; EPC must be fixed in the property (often meter cupboard or by the boiler); £500 penalty charge for homes
- EPC reform: from 30 April 2028 new-style Scottish EPCs with Heat Retention, Heating System and Energy Cost ratings, valid five years; transition to 30 April 2029
- Legionella: Repairing Standard guidance requires private landlords to assess legionella risk before first let and review at intervals of no more than two years; no legionella certificate exists
- Group companies: Scottish Energy Services (SAP, SBEM, commercial EPCs); Fire Risk Scotland (https://fireriskscotland.com/, fire risk assessments)

## Services
- [Domestic EPC Scotland](https://www.scotlandepc.com/domestic-epc/): Domestic Energy Performance Certificates for flats and houses in Glasgow, Edinburgh and the Central Belt. What an EPC shows, when you need one in Scotland, what happens on the survey, and prices from £70 + VAT.
- [Legionella Risk Assessment for Landlords in Scotland](https://www.scotlandepc.com/legionella-risk-assessment/): Legionella risk assessments for private landlords, letting agents and short-term let hosts in Glasgow, Edinburgh and the Central Belt. What Scottish law requires, what we check, and what you get. From £65, or £120 with an EPC, plus VAT.
- [EPC Prices Glasgow & Edinburgh](https://www.scotlandepc.com/prices/): Clear prices for domestic EPCs and legionella risk assessments: EPCs from £70 for a flat and £85 for a house, legionella from £65, both together £120, all plus VAT. Check your price by postcode.
- [EPC Rating Estimator for Scottish Homes](https://www.scotlandepc.com/epc-rating-estimator/): Get a rough EPC band for your Scottish home in under a minute, and see which improvements would raise it most: loft insulation, cavity walls, a new boiler, double glazing or solar panels.

## Guides
- [EPC Changes in Scotland 2028: New Ratings & 5-Year Validity](https://www.scotlandepc.com/epc-changes-2028/): Scotland's new-style EPCs start on 30 April 2028: three headline ratings (Heat Retention, Heating System, Energy Cost), five-year validity and a one-year transition. What changes and what landlords and sellers should do now.
- [Landlord Compliance Checklist Scotland: EPC, Legionella, EICR, Gas](https://www.scotlandepc.com/landlords/): A checklist of the safety and paperwork every private let in Scotland needs: landlord registration, EPC, legionella risk assessment, gas safety, EICR and PAT, smoke, heat and CO alarms, deposits and tenancy terms.
- [EPC & Legionella Questions Answered](https://www.scotlandepc.com/faq/): Answers about domestic EPCs and legionella risk assessments in Scotland: prices, how long an EPC lasts, the 2028 changes, landlord rules, access, timings and what happens on the visit.
